title: FairPvP
description: FairPvP by ZDev is an innovative Minecraft server plugin designed to create a fairer and more dynamic PvP experience.
body:
**FairPvP is a groundbreaking combat balancing plugin that brings a new level of fairness and dynamic challenge to your Minecraft server's PvP experience. Tired of one-sided duels where gear determines the victor? This plugin intelligently adjusts player kits in real-time, ensuring competitive and engaging fights for everyone.**

**What does it do?**

• Dynamically Balances:

• Duels: Automatically adjusts player kits (gear sets) during duels based on round performance, ensuring competitive fights.

• Intelligent Kit Degradation/Improvement: If a player consistently wins, their kit gradually "degrades" (e.g., lower enchantments, simpler materials, fewer consumables), while their opponent's kit "improves" to level the playing field.

• Diverse & Granular Kits: Generates a wide range of unique PvP kits with clear, distinct changes in:
Armor material (Diamond to Leather).
Staggered enchantment levels on individual armor pieces and weapons.
Presence and quantity of essential consumables (ender pearls, arrows, food, golden apples).
Utility items (shields, blocks, pickaxes, flint and steel).

• Player State Management: Resets player health, hunger, inventory, potion effects, and teleports them to spawn after each round and at duel's end.

• Customizable Kit:

• Generation: Configurable number of kits and the initial rounds where kit balancing is most active.

**Robust Command **

• Permissions: Controls access to duel commands (/duel, /duel stop) via a flexible permission system.

• Works seamlessly with Paper 1.21.1+ (or your specified API version).

**Why should you use it?**

• Promotes Skill over Gear: Ensures that player skill, rather than just superior equipment, is the primary factor in PvP outcomes.

• Engages All Players: Keeps duels exciting and challenging for both experienced combatants and newer players by maintaining balanced competition.

• Reduces Frustration: Minimizes the feeling of unfairness from being out-geared, encouraging more participation in PvP.

• Highly Configurable: Easily adjust kit generation parameters and balancing thresholds via a YAML configuration file.

• Lightweight and Efficient: Designed to run smoothly with minimal impact on server performance.

**Perfect for:**

• Competitive PvP servers
• PvP arenas and training servers
• Community servers
• Any server aiming for fair and dynamic combat experiences
